headline: ARC Prize reports Haiku 5.5 results across all three ARC tests

sections.text: ARC Prize reports Haiku 5.5 scored 61.3% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.085 per task. On ARC-AGI-3, it reached 2.8% at $437 with the provider adapter and 0.5% at $388 with the standard harness. These are model evaluations, separate from Kaggle team standings.
The organization says it omitted the max-reasoning ARC-AGI-2 result: only 74 of 120 tasks completed, with many unfinished attempts exhausting their output budget before producing parseable answers.
